SRC-166:R001.text: "Self-check before sending" must not be the only enforcement boundary.

SRC-166:R002.text: For normal operational outputs, the model must not control the final response shape freely.

SRC-166:R003.text: The regression suite must include repeated-turn testing:

SRC-166:R004.text:
The regression suite must include repeated-turn testing:
turn 1:
        model attempts oversized response
        -> blocked/compressed

    turn 2:
        fresh response, same semantic pressure
        -> blocked/compressed again

    turn 3:
        large evidence set
        -> still compact

SRC-166:R005.text:
Acceptance requires the invalid response to become mechanically unreachable
where the host capability allows it.
